_comment: nvitk XNAT connection profile. Copy to a config directory (see `nvitk-config path`) as
CREDENTIALS: do not put a password in this file, and prefer keeping the username out of
it too — this file is easy to copy into a repo or a shared drive by accident. nvitk
resolves credentials in this order, and any of them is a better home than this file:
$XNAT_SERVER and $XNAT_PROJECT likewise override the values below, so a shared profile
can be committed while per-user details stay in the environment.
_comment_verify: TLS certificate verification. Keep true. Set false only for a server behind an internal
CA whose root certificate you cannot install.
